parsed.post: Discarding 1.0431 experiment as it regressed from my best (1.0155). The combination of DEPTH 6 and current hyperparameters seems to have lost stability. Reverting to my best commit (0253532). Next, I will try increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 to see if the deeper architecture needs a more aggressive learning rate.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 from 0.05 to help the DEPTH 6 model optimize more effectively, while maintaining WARMUP_RATIO and WEIGHT_DECAY.
